reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Room performance, bookings made, and cancellations and no-shows for the period you choose, compared with the same dates last year.
reports.basis: Room revenue = nights price after discount, without tax and service, counted on the night stayed. Extras (late check-out/early check-in fees) are shown apart. Available nights = active villas × nights, minus maintenance nights.
reports.greyIsLastYear: Grey figures underneath: the same dates last year.
reports.madeIntro: Bookings made in this period (booking date), including those cancelled later. Holds that were never paid are not counted.
reports.noBookings: No bookings were made in this period.
reports.lostIntro: Cancellations of confirmed bookings by cancellation date; no-shows by arrival date.
reports.ratesNote: Cancellation rate = cancellations ÷ bookings made in the same period. No-show rate = no-shows ÷ arrivals due in this period.
reports.paceIntro: Nights and room revenue already booked for the coming months, compared with the same point last year, and how much was added this week.
reports.paceAsOf: Position today ({today}) for stay dates up to {to}, compared with the position on {lyToday} for the dates a year earlier. Pickup = change over the last {days} days.
reports.paceBasis: Counted on the books: bookings made by that date, ever confirmed, and not yet cancelled then. Room revenue after discount, without tax and service.
reports.lyFinalNote: Last year final result for the same months: {revenue}, {nights} nights, occupancy {occupancy}. The gap is what is still to win.
reports.otbOccupancyByMonth: Occupancy on the books by month
reports.otbRevenueByMonth: Room revenue on the books by month
reports.paceLimit: Note: bookings whose dates changed are counted on their current dates and price; available nights use the current villa status.
reports.schedulesIntro: Reports sent by email from {hour} property time: daily (yesterday and today), weekly on Monday (last 7 days and pace, with Excel files) and monthly on the 1st (last month, with an Excel file). Choose who receives each one.
reports.emailNotConfigured: Email is not set up yet (Resend keys): reports wait and are skipped after 3 days. You can still preview them here.

channels.intro: Sync each villa calendar with Airbnb, Booking.com or other channels by iCal. Channel calendars are read every {minutes} minutes; stays from other channels block those dates here automatically.
channels.how1: Copy this villa "Our calendar" link and paste it into the channel calendar settings (Airbnb: Availability → Connect another calendar; Booking.com: Rates & Availability → Sync calendars → Import).
channels.how2: In the same channel, copy their calendar export link (ending in .ics) and add it under "Channel calendars".
channels.how3: Repeat for every villa and every channel. Channels usually read our calendar a few times a day, so keep an eye on the conflicts list.

rates.intro: Rates per villa type, seasons, weekend rates, dates closed to arrival, rate plans, automatic discounts and promo codes. Changes apply to new bookings; existing bookings keep their price.
rates.offersIntro: Offered to every villa type of this property, on the website and for staff bookings.
rates.nonRefundableHint: Paid in full at booking; nothing is refunded on cancellation.
rates.breakfastHint: Added to the nights' price for every guest (adults and children). Service and tax apply.
rates.longStayHint: Up to three tiers, e.g. 7 nights 10%, 14 nights 15%. The highest tier the stay reaches applies.
rates.stackRule: Only one discount applies per booking: the largest of promo code, early-bird, long-stay or a staff discount. The non-refundable discount comes first and is always combined.
rates.typeIntro: Base rate {base} · Friday and Saturday nights {weekend}
rates.noSeasons: No seasons: every night uses the base rate.
rates.closuresIntro: Guests cannot arrive on these dates (they can still stay over them). Useful for Nyepi or for keeping long stays over peak dates.
rates.noClosures: No dates are closed to arrival.
rates.promosIntro: Codes guests type at checkout (staff can use them too). A code is never deleted; switch it off instead.
rates.newPromoIntro: Leave a field empty for no limit. Dates are inclusive.

errors.not_found: Not found or no longer available.
errors.role: Only the branch manager of this property can change rates.
errors.invalid: Check the numbers: rates and amounts must be whole rupiah above 0, percentages between 0.01 and 90.
errors.dates: Check the dates: the end must be after the start.
errors.overlap: This season overlaps another season of the same villa type.
errors.code_taken: This code already exists at this property.
errors.tiers: Check the long-stay tiers: at least 2 nights each, different nights, and a percentage between 0.01 and 90.
errors.times: The latest late check-out must be after the normal check-out time, and the earliest early check-in before the normal check-in time.

rates.guestTimesTitle: Flexible times guests can ask for
rates.guestTimesIntro: From their booking page guests may ask for a late check-out (after {checkOut}) or an early check-in (before {checkIn}); staff still approve each request, and later or earlier times can be arranged at the desk.

owners.title: Owners
owners.intro: Monthly statements per villa owner: room revenue per night stayed (net of discount, without tax and service), minus channel commission, the management fee and expenses.
owners.setupIntro: Who owns each villa, the agreed management fee, and channel commission.
owners.expensesIntro: Costs charged to villa owners. A month is closed for an owner once their statement is locked.
owners.formula: Owner's share = room revenue − channel commission − management fee (a share of revenue after commission) − expenses.
owners.monthOpen: This month has not ended yet: figures still change and statements can be locked from the 1st of next month.
owners.noOwners: No villa has an owner in this month yet. Set owners under Owners & villas.
owners.villasIntro: Changing the owner ends the previous owner's period on that date; the month is split between them. Changes cannot reach back into a locked month.
owners.ownersIntro: Contact details are shown on the statement. They are not written to the activity log.
owners.commissionIntro: Share of room revenue paid to the sales channel, by booking source. It comes off before the management fee.
owners.addExpenseIntro: Charged to whoever owned the villa on that date. Use Adjustment with a minus amount to give money back to an owner.
owners.recurringIntro: Charged every month automatically, shared by days owned when the owner changes mid-month.

errors.not_found: Not found or no longer available.
errors.role: Your role cannot do this for this property.
errors.invalid: Check the entries: names, amounts (whole rupiah) and percentages (0–100).
errors.dates: Check the dates: an owner can only be set from after the villa's latest ownership started, and an end must be after the start.
errors.overlap: This period overlaps another owner's period for the villa.
errors.month_locked: That month is already locked for the owner. Record a correction as an adjustment in the next month.
errors.no_owner: The villa had no owner on that date. Set the owner first.
errors.month_not_over: The month has not ended yet; it can be locked from the 1st of next month.
errors.already_paid: This statement is already marked paid.

guests.title: Guests
guests.intro: One profile per guest: bookings with the same email, or the same phone without another email, are joined automatically. Notes and tags are internal and never shown to guests.
guests.name: Name
guests.anonymizedOn: Personal data erased on {date} at the guest's request.
guests.anonymizedHint: This guest's personal data was erased (UU PDP). Bookings and amounts remain for the accounts.
guests.notesPlaceholder: e.g. allergic to nuts, prefers feather pillows, celebrates anniversary in June
guests.notesHint: Internal only: shown to staff on the guest's bookings, never to the guest.
guests.duplicatesIntro: Same name, email or phone. Merging moves all their bookings here and combines notes and tags.
guests.privacyIntro: When a guest asks for their data: download everything held about them. When they ask for deletion: erase their personal data. Bookings and amounts stay for the accounts.
guests.anonymizeConfirm: I confirm the guest asked for their personal data to be deleted. Name, contact details, notes, requests, pre-check-in details and messages will be erased permanently.
guests.apoaIntro: Foreign guests must be reported to immigration through APOA within 24 hours of arrival. This list comes from the pre-check-in; download the CSV to enter into APOA, then mark the bookings as reported.
guests.csvNote: The CSV contains full document numbers; each download is recorded on the bookings it contains. Numbers are erased 30 days after check-out.
guests.apoaSummary: {dates}: {count} bookings with foreign guests, {pending} not reported yet.
guests.missingPreCheckin: Foreign guest without pre-check-in: take the passport details at check-in.
guests.noForeign: No foreign guests arriving on these dates.

errors.not_found: Not found or no longer available.
errors.invalid: Check the entries: name, a valid email, an email or phone, a 2-letter country code.
errors.duplicate: Another profile already has this email or phone. It is listed under “Possibly the same guest”: merge it instead.
errors.anonymized: This guest's personal data has been erased.
errors.active_booking: The guest still has an active booking (held, confirmed or in house). Erase their data after it ends or is cancelled.

addons.checkoutIntro: Chosen add-ons are added to your total (the deposit includes them); the final amount is shown on the payment step. Our team confirms each one and lets you know; anything we cannot arrange is refunded.
addons.portalIntro: Request an experience for your stay. Our team confirms it and adds it to your bill; you pay with the balance or at the villa.
addons.leadNote: Please request at least {hours} hours ahead.

messages.sent: Request sent. We will confirm it soon.
messages.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.

errors.not_allowed: Add-ons can be requested for confirmed bookings only.
errors.invalid_date: Choose a day within your stay.
errors.too_late: This is too close to the time requested. Please contact us directly.
errors.invalid_count: Check the number of persons, nights or quantity.
errors.already_decided: This request has already been handled.
errors.charge_failed: The charge could not be updated.

addons.declineReason: Reason (shown to the guest as not available)
addons.staffAddHint: Confirmed at once and added to the bill; it also appears on the task board. The notice period does not apply.
addons.catalogIntro: Add-ons and experiences guests can book at checkout or from their booking page. Prices include tax and service, like other charges.
addons.newAddonIntro: Name it in both languages. Changing a price later does not change orders already placed.

catalogErrors.role: Only the branch manager can change the catalog.
catalogErrors.invalid: Check the entries: both names, a price in whole rupiah above 0, notice between 0 and 720 hours.

portal.earlyIntro: Check-in is from {time}. Ask to arrive earlier; we confirm once we know the villa will be ready.
portal.earlyRequested: Your request to arrive from {time} is waiting for confirmation.
portal.earlyApprovedFee: Early check-in from {time} is confirmed, with a fee of {amount} added to your bill.
portal.earlyDeclined: Sorry, we cannot offer early check-in from {time}.
portal.earlyNone: Early check-in cannot be requested for this booking any more. Please contact us.

earlyMessages.sent: Request sent. We will confirm soon.
earlyMessages.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.
earlyMessages.not_allowed: Early check-in can no longer be requested for this booking.
earlyMessages.already_requested: You already have a request waiting.
earlyMessages.time_unavailable: That time is no longer possible. Please choose another.

portal.datesIntro: Choose new dates to see the price. Our team confirms the change; nights you already booked keep their price.
portal.datesOtherVilla: Your villa is taken on those dates, but another villa of the same type is free; our team will confirm the price.
portal.datesFinePrint: Nothing changes until we confirm. A late check-out or early check-in request tied to the old dates is cancelled.
portal.datesRequested: Your request to change to {dates} is waiting for confirmation.
portal.datesDeclined: Your request to change to {dates} could not be accepted

dateMessages.sent: Request sent. We will confirm soon.
dateMessages.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.

dateErrors.not_allowed: Date changes can be requested for confirmed bookings before arrival.
dateErrors.already_requested: You already have a date change request waiting.
dateErrors.invalid_dates: Check the dates: check-out must be after check-in.
dateErrors.check_in_in_past: The new check-in date has passed.
dateErrors.min_stay: The minimum stay for that arrival is {nights} nights.
dateErrors.dates_unavailable: No villa of this type is free on those dates.
dateErrors.unit_blocked: No villa of this type is free on those dates.
dateErrors.channel_booked: No villa of this type is free on those dates.
dateErrors.price_changed: The price changed; please check again.

portal.staffRequested: The guest asks to change to {dates}.
portal.staffPrice: Price now on the current villa: {total} ({difference}).
portal.staffOtherVilla: The current villa is taken; choose another free villa of the same type.
portal.staffNoVilla: No villa of this type is free on those dates: decline with a reason.
portal.staffHint: Approving applies the usual date-change rules at today's price and tells the guest.

reportMail.attached: The full figures are in the attached Excel files.
reportMail.footer: Sent automatically by {brand}. Ask your branch manager to change who receives it.
